messages:
alex-cs: @maya @samir - incoming from a high-value customer: sudden 502s and timeouts hitting hosted inference since the staged rollout. They attached a repro curl. spike started ~10:05 UTC. cc @ryan for oncall

maya: saw alerts. percent 5xx up ~18% on api-router across eu-west1 and us-central. any recent route/key changes? :eyes:

samir: deployment `release/2026-03-18-17` rolled to 20% traffic at 10:02 UTC (staged seed). no infra changes afaik, but there was an envkey swap in the rollout manifest: `INFER_AUTH_HEADER=redwood-x` -> `INFER_AUTH_HEADER=redwood-v2`.

ryan: grabbing logs from edge gateway now. timeline pls and repro steps from customer?

alex-cs: customer repro (anonymized):
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-XXXX" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"input":"hello"}' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Response snippet: `502 Bad Gateway` and sometimes `upstream read timeout`

deploy-bot: Deployment event: release/2026-03-18-17 staged rollout -> 20% at 10:02:41 UTC by samir. Configuration change: envkey INFER_AUTH_HEADER updated.

maya: logs show a surge of `auth header missing` traces at the router for the seeded slice. Headers are hitting the backend as `Authorization:` (empty) for ~12% of the requests routed to the new variant. upstream returned 502 when model proxy tried to validate empty token.

samir: that suggests header name swap caused some proxies to strip the header. The new envkey expects `redwood-v2` header name and older sidecars still rely on `redwood-x`. Looks like the rollout mixed both header expectations.

ryan: can we reproduce locally by toggling header name? I'll run quick traffic against the staged slice. alex-cs can you ask customer if they used an API gateway or sentinel that rewrites headers?

alex-cs: customer says they put a short-lived gateway in front yesterday for rate-limiting — could be trimming the header length. they saw tokens truncated. they also attached a sample raw request header: `Authorization: Bearer sk-pr...` truncated to `Authorization:` in some logs.

maya: ok plan: 1) pause staged rollout -> drop traffic to 0% on release/2026-03-18-17, 2) roll back envkey change in the variant, 3) validate end-to-end with customer-repro. I'm executing pause now.

samir: agreed. also will push a guard to reject requests where Authorization header length < 20 with a 401 instead of letting upstream throw 502. that will make error mode safer and faster to triage.

deploy-bot: Action executed: Staged rollout paused for release/2026-03-18-17 at 10:06:12 UTC (traffic -> 0%).

ryan: after pause, 5xx% dropped back to baseline within ~90s. verifying traces now.

alex-cs: customer confirmed immediate reduction in errors on their side. they can repro with header rewrite if we need a test partner. :thumbsup:

maya: follow-ups: - run a quick audit of any header-name changes in rollout manifests next 24h - add a lint to detect auth envkey swaps without compat shim - update runbook step to prefer returning 401 for header validation failures.

samir: noted. I'll open a PR for the lint and the 401 guard. tagging this as mitigated; will create a postmortem if we find any customer billing impact.

alex-cs: customer asks for timeline note and confirmation they won't be charged for failed requests during the window. I'll coordinate with billing ops.

ryan: good catch all. leaving oncall watch for 30m then handoff. :rotating_light:
